chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Hashim, from Abi Khadija, who said:
The stone (in the ring) should be circular. And he (peace be upon him) said: 'This is how the ring of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to be.'

key_terms.الْفَصُّ: The stone or gem set in a ring

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended shape for the stone in a Muslim's ring according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) regarding the aesthetic and structural design of rings, specifically endorsing a circular ('modawwar') shape for the stone or seal. In Shia jurisprudence, this serves as a primary textual basis for the recommendation (mustahabb) of circular stones in signet rings, distinguishing it from other shapes while affirming the Prophet's personal practice as a model for believers.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, form Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Hashim, from Abu Khadeeja who said,
‘The stone (in the ring) should be circular’. And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This is how the ring of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> used to be’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from ‘Abd al- Rahman ibn Hashim from abu Khadijah who has said the following:

“He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘The stone of a ring is round and that is how the ring of the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, was.’”
